newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen up on sustained foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen up on sustained foreign buying.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to rise slightly on Friday on continued foreign buying of discounted stocks, brokers said.

"Liquidity in the market is quite high due to foreign capital inflows earlier this week. I expect that foreigners will continue to accumulate large capitalised stocks today," said Samart Rusmeerojwong of James Capel Asia.
The composite SET index advanced 13.62 points to 649.33 on 8.06 billion baht turnover on Thursday. The SET-50 index gained 1.26 points to 49.19.
